assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: editorial photograph for a premium French health and sports website, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: exceptionally photorealistic luxury editorial yoga photograph, maximum resolution offered, exquisite fine detail with an 8K photographic aesthetic.
Scene/backdrop: an understated generic wellness studio with pale oak floor, warm off-white plaster, a lightly textured ecru linen curtain and soft natural side-window daylight. Discreet and believable, airy atmosphere, absolutely no sign, logo or branding.
Subject: one adult woman, approximately 35 years old, ordinary healthy athletic physique, natural skin texture, wearing full matte dusty blue-gray leggings and a matching modest athletic top. She is practising anatomically correct Warrior II yoga, front knee bent above ankle, rear leg straight, front foot aligned with mat, rear foot turned outward, torso upright, both arms extended horizontally and aligned to the legs, hands relaxed, gaze calmly over front fingertips. Both bare feet entirely visible and grounded on a simple subdued blue/linen textured yoga mat. Natural, correct body proportions and five fingers on each hand.
Style/medium: high-end real editorial lifestyle photography, photographed with a full-frame camera and a 50mm lens. Skin pores, fine hairs, fabric weave and natural folds preserved. Real optical depth of field, gentle tonal rolloff, rich restrained colors.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 3:2, full body with breathing space around hands and feet, eye-level camera, quiet balanced composition. Do not crop feet or fingers.
Lighting/mood: soft natural lateral daylight, no harsh studio flash, believable shadows, calm refined warmth.
Avoid: CGI, render, plastic skin, artificial smoothing, theatrical luxury, oversaturated colors, excessive sharpening, lens flare, duplicated anatomy, extra fingers, contorted limbs, floating feet, written text, watermark.
This is a newly generated illustrative scene: no depiction of a named real clinic or any real member of its team.

assets.inspection: Pose guerrier II crédible, doigts et pieds visibles, matières et lumière naturelles.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: premium editorial healthcare photograph for a French health and sports website, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: exceptionally realistic professional photograph of a gentle osteopathy consultation, maximum resolution offered, exquisite fine detail with an 8K photographic aesthetic.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet generic consultation room, warm off-white plaster, pale oak detail and ecru linen under soft natural side-window daylight. Background softly out of focus, discreetly elegant rather than ostentatious. No branding, text or identifiable real place.
Subject: close-up of the real-looking hands of one adult healthcare practitioner gently cradling the nape and base of the skull of one adult patient lying comfortably face-up on a padded examination table. A relaxed neutral neck position, no forceful twist. Exactly two practitioner hands, with anatomically natural fingers and plausible supportive placement under the occiput and the side of the neck. The practitioner wears a plain muted blue-gray clean short sleeve healthcare tunic with natural fabric weave; show only hands, forearms and a small cropped portion of torso. The adult patient wears a modest off-white top, with shoulders covered; the patient's face is only partially in frame at the edge, relaxed expression, not an identity portrait. A simple fresh ecru cotton cover on the treatment table.
Style/medium: high-end real editorial healthcare photography, full-frame camera with 85mm lens, shallow but realistic depth of field, focus sharp on the practitioner's hands and the patient's nape. Natural skin pores, tiny creases, normal fingernails, subtle variation in skin coloration, true cotton fibers and folds. Understated luxury, documentary credibility.
Composition/framing: close-up wide landscape 3:2, camera near table level slightly above, a calm intimate composition with hands clearly legible, the patient's face partially cropped at frame edge. Hands must not appear to emerge from the same arm; physically coherent human anatomy.
Lighting/mood: broad soft lateral natural daylight, neutral warm whites, believable soft contact shadows, gentle contrast and fine tonal detail.
Avoid: spa massage stereotypes, candles, instruments, forceful manipulation, neck cracking, pressure marks, any appearance of pain, extra fingers or hands, fused hands, CGI, 3D rendering, waxy skin, artificial smoothing, oversaturated colors, synthetic bokeh, extreme sharpening, written text, logo, watermark.
This is a newly generated illustrative scene, not a depiction of a named real clinic, patient or member of its team.
